FilevineAccessTokenCredential.title: Filevine Access Token
FilevineAccessTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste a Filevine Identity bearer access token and your Filevine organisation ID. Use the access_token returned by the Identity token exchange, not the personal access token used to obtain it. The token needs fv.api.gateway.access, tenant and filevine.v2.api.* access. Triggers also need filevine.v2.webhooks. Paste only the token without Bearer. Access tokens expire; replace it here when it expires. NoClick does not renew this token.
